HRRI: Diagnostics for Soil-Plant-Microbial Redox Recovery

Source: R/HRRI-package.R
HRRI-package.Rd

HRRI keeps two kinds of quantity apart. Mechanistic quantities – event-window accessible electron capacity and stoichiometric oxygen demand – are computed from inventories, accessibility and exchange rates that the user declares, and are never estimated from the scores. Observational quantities – domain scores and recovery descriptors built from aligned soil, plant and microbial measurements – carry their orientation, coverage and estimability with them, so an unsupported value is reported as missing rather than defaulted.

Where to start

  • vignette("HRRI_workflow", package = "HRRI") for an end-to-end run.

  • vignette("HRRI_gallery", package = "HRRI") for how to read the figures.

  • vignette("HRRI_paper_figures", package = "HRRI") to reproduce the six manuscript figures.

What the package does not claim

Simulated demonstrations verify accounting and analytical behaviour. They are not environmental validation, and a statistically identifiable \(\alpha\) or \(k\) is not a mechanistically identified one.
